statement: The record shows the requested access level is **owner of the whole company's systems**, but contractors on project P-4 only receive **editor on P-4**.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the requested "owner of the whole company's systems" conflicts with the rule that contractors only get project-scoped access, and supplies the correct level ("editor on P-4").
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
